title: RepoAssure AI IDE Repair Workflow Packed CLI Installation Validation v0.1
objective: Validate a locally packed RepoAssure distribution in an isolated temporary consumer, including package contents, hardening bin resolution, repair command help and a no-write fixture smoke, without publishing npm.
acceptance: Create a local package tarball without publishing it and inspect the packed file manifest for required CLI and runtime files.
Install the local tarball in an isolated temporary consumer and invoke the resolved hardening bin as an external process.
Validate repair command help plus a bounded no-write fixture smoke without relying on the source workspace node_modules layout.
Prove no target repository source change, branch, commit, push, pull request, deployment, or publication occurs.
Cascade package-installation evidence through operations, testing, acceptance, canonical docs, logs, and Autopilot state.
